programme.title: Storage 24
programme.desc: A group of friends are stalked through a grueling maze of claustrophobic corridors by a terrifying, tentacle-faced creature that eviscerates its victims.

programme.title: Tiger House
programme.desc: A young gymnast (Kaya Scodelario) battles a group of bank robbers at the home of her boyfriend.

programme.title: Shuttle
programme.desc: Two friends (Cameron Goodman, Peyton List) become caught up in an airport shuttle driver's (Tony Curran) deadly game.

programme.title: The Grind
programme.desc: To pay his gambling debts, a grifter (C. Thomas Howell) launches a website that exploits women.

programme.title: The Canyon
programme.desc: A honeymooning couple has to survive in the Grand Canyon after getting lost.

programme.title: Dead Bodies
programme.desc: Events spin out of control after a young man (Andrew Scott) deposits his lover's corpse in a shallow grave that is already occupied.

programme.title: Surveillance
programme.desc: FBI agents (Julia Ormond, Bill Pullman) interrogate witnesses who survive the bloody rampage of two serial killers.

programme.title: Love in the Time of Monsters
programme.desc: Two sisters staying in a tourist trap battle toxic monsters wearing Bigfoot costumes to save the ones they love.

programme.title: The Sacrament
programme.desc: Found footage reveals the events surrounding an investigative team's visit to a remote commune, led by a dangerous fanatic who maintains an iron grip on his followers.

programme.title: The 13th Summer
programme.desc: During their annual vacation to the beach, Ben and Vee encounter a mysterious hiker who draws them into a twisted web of lies, deceit, revenge and ultimately, murder.

programme.title: Apartment 143
programme.desc: Hired to debunk a supposed haunting, paranormal investigators come face-to-face with an angry spirit more terrifying than they have ever imagined.

programme.title: Alone
programme.desc: A cold-blooded killer hunts a widow in the wilderness after she escapes from his remote cabin in the Pacific Northwest.

programme.title: But Deliver Us From Evil
programme.desc: Lilith, a succubus, emerges in the present day to seek revenge against mankind for her expulsion from the Garden of Eden.

programme.title: Don't Come Back Alive
programme.desc: A police detective, prosecutor and beat cop must stop a serial killer before they strike again.

programme.title: Grand Piano
programme.desc: A concert pianist who has stage fright finds a threatening note written on his sheet music just moments before a performance.

programme.title: All Good Things
programme.desc: The marriage between the heir (Ryan Gosling) to a real-estate fortune and a woman (Kirsten Dunst) of modest means goes south after the husband returns to work for his demanding father.

programme.title: The Fiancé
programme.desc: When a beautiful bride-to-be is bitten by the legendary creature Bigfoot, she becomes a brutal force of nature, hellbent on breaking her engagement... and her fiancé.

programme.title: Black Death
programme.desc: A monk investigates rumors of people being resurrected during an outbreak of the bubonic plague.

programme.title: Bonnie & Clyde vs. Dracula
programme.desc: Gangsters and vampires collide in a gory battle.

programme.title: Man Finds Tape
programme.desc: When a man reaches out to his sister with surveillance footage of a murder in their hometown, she reluctantly returns to help him investigate. She soon uncovers a disturbing secret that's tied to a decades-old supernatural phenomenon.

programme.title: VHS
programme.desc: Hired to steal a rare VHS tape from a remote house, a ragtag band of crooks finds a dead body, old TVs and a lot of cryptic footage.

programme.title: VHS 2
programme.desc: As they search for clues to the whereabouts of a missing student, a couple view the ghastly stories recorded on a collection of videotapes.

programme.title: VHS: Viral
programme.desc: A police chase through the streets of Los Angeles inspires dozens of fame-obsessed teens to try to capture the salacious footage, but they are unaware that they will face their own deaths as stars of the next video sensation.

programme.title: Censor
programme.desc: A British film censor links a disturbing horror movie to her sister's mysterious disappearance.

programme.title: Heretic
programme.desc: A modern-day psychic using occult practices to communicate with the dead experiences an evil beyond human comprehension.

programme.title: Amulet
programme.desc: Terror strikes when a former soldier takes a job to help a young woman and her housebound mother.

programme.title: The Carpenter's Son
programme.desc: A remote village in Egypt explodes into spiritual warfare when a carpenter, his wife and their son Jesus are targeted by supernatural forces.

programme.title: You're All Gonna Die
programme.desc: A group of social justice warriors, in a quest to free an innocent man, search an abandoned campground for a serial killer. All of them is picked off one by one until it comes down to last person against the killer.

programme.title: The ABCs of Death
programme.desc: An anthology of stories helmed by more than two dozen directors details 26 ways to die, each corresponding to a different letter of the alphabet.

programme.title: ABCs of Death 2

programme.title: Kiss of the Damned

programme.desc: A lonely misfit (Kåre Hedebrant) finds a soul mate in the form of a vampire child (Lina Leandersson) who recently became his neighbor.

programme.title: The Signal
programme.desc: A woman (Anessa Ramsey) and her lover (Justin Welborn) get caught up in the madness and must escape when a mysterious transmission turns people into murderous lunatics.

programme.title: XX
programme.desc: Four horrific tales of terror revolve around a mysterious gift box, a death at a birthday party, a camping trip gone awry and the child from hell.

programme.desc: A grieving man relocates his two teenage daughters to a charming town and into their dream home. Quickly, the dream becomes an inescapable nightmare.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Nashville Hot Pheasant and Mint Basil Lemonade
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern takes a spin on Nashville-style hot fried chicken. Hot and spicy, batter coated, crispy fried pheasant is paired with a spinach salad topped with bacon vinaigrette and ice-cold mint basil lemonade.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Grilled Yellowtail Collars & Filets with Miso Sauce

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Venison Paillard and Hearty Hunter's Stew

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.sub-title: Wild Boar Feast: Chorizo with Mussels and Whole Roasted Leg
programme.desc: Wild boar takes center stage! Andrew makes chorizo with mussels, preserved lemon & white wine. Then, he slow-roasts a whole leg over fire, served Southern-style with pickled cherries, glazed onions & mustard sauce.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern showcases quail two ways: classic Southern fried quail with lemon-basil aioli, and as an elevated topping for a traditional open-fire paella, complete with crispy socarrat. He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.sub-title: Tasty Ant Eggs in Ninh Binh
programme.desc: After a long trip from Hue, Luke finally gets some rest in the scenic Ninh Bihn. Tag along as Luke meets with a local rice farmer, takes a canoe out for some crab hunting, and ventures deep into the jungle in search of a local delicacy- red ant eggs!

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.sub-title: Searching For The Banh Da Noodle in Hai Phong
programme.desc: Luke is in northern Vietnam- Hai Phong! This is the birthplace of his partner Lynne. Join Luke as he meets some of Lynne's family for the first time, and tries the delicious Banh Da Noodle- a tasty dish that Hai Phong is renowned for!

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.desc: Luke's penultimate stop on his train journey is Hanoi. Follow Luke on his hunt for an iconic Hanoi dish, Bun Cha. Luke takes a ride on the Reunification Express railway, and visits the famous Hoan Kiem Lake for some delicious magenta sticky rice.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.desc: Nearing the end of his Vietnamese journey, Luke stops in Sapa, a hilltop region that he remembers from his travels fifteen years ago. Join Luke as he rekindles a friendship from his previous visit and learns about a local dish of dried buffalo.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Temozón is the birthplace of Yucatán's signature smoked meat Carne Ahumada and everyone in town claims to have a relative who invented it. Pati strolls around town to try different versions of Carne Ahumada.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.sub-title: A Mayan League of their Own
programme.desc: In Yaxunah, Pati discovers Yucatán's league of their own. She joins the Amazonas, a softball team of indigenous women, for their morning practice. As they built a name for themselves, they overcame the mindset that women belong in the kitchen.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In Tucson, Pati learns the basics of artisan bread-making from Don Guerra of Barrio Bakery. She crosses into Sonora, Mexico, to see where the wheat is from. Back in her kitchen, Pati creates a menu of tasty recipes using wheat flour.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In Guadalajara, Pati learns the secrets to menudo and birria. In her kitchen, Pati perfects her own recipes for a few Jalisco favorites: menudo, tepache, and jericalla.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati spends a day in Sonora's capital, Hermosillo, visiting some of the city's best culinary destinations. From gigantic burritos at Doña Guille to Sonoran hot dogs, Pati experiences all Hermosillo's food scene has to offer.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: On the coast in Bahía Kino, local fishermen catch giant sea scallops. Then, in the mountain town of Matape, Nere, one of Sonora's few female butchers shares her wisdom with Pati.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati explores some unique spots in Guadalajara where food and art truly connect. In her kitchen, she makes pollo a la valentina, rice with poblanos and corn, and an almond tres leches cake.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati meets the young chefs behind one of Guadalajara's most exciting restaurants, Xokol. Back home, Pati invites her friend Francisco Migoya over to make conchas to go with pellizcadas with chicharrón in salsa verde.
